
=== WebPanel: Produccion.listarTurnos ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFTurnoHoraFin_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_TurnoHoraFinAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFTurnoHoraInicio_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_TurnoHoraInicioAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Turno'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarTurnosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarTurnosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	TurnoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	TurnoHoraInicio.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	TurnoHoraFin.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TurnoNombre'
					&TFTurnoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFTurnoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TurnoHoraInicio'
					&TFTurnoHoraInicio.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.Set(&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.Year(), &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.Month(), &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TurnoHoraFin'
					&TFTurnoHoraFin.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFTurnoHoraFin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFTurnoHoraFin_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFTurnoHoraFin_To.Set(&TFTurnoHoraFin_To.Year(), &TFTurnoHoraFin_To.Month(), &TFTurnoHoraFin_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarTurno.Link(TrnMode.Display, TurnoId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarTurno.Link(TrnMode.Update, TurnoId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarTurno.Link(TrnMode.Delete, TurnoId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.listarTurnosColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarTurnosFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarTurnosFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarTurnosFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarTurno.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &TurnoId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarTurno ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&AuditTableName = !'Turno'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'turno_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'turno_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'turno_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&Turno.Load(&TurnoId)
			&LoadSuccess = &Turno.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &Turno.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				Turno_TurnoEnum.Enabled = False
				Turno_TurnoNombre.Enabled = False
				Turno_TurnoHoraInicio.Enabled = False
				Turno_TurnoHoraFin.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	Turno_TurnoId.Visible = False
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &TurnoId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	If &TurnoId > 0
		&Turno.TurnoEnum = EnumTurno.Convert(&TurnoId)
	EndIf

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
&Turno.TurnoId = &Turno.TurnoEnum
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&Turno.Delete()
			Else
				&Turno.Save()
			EndIf
			If &Turno.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &Turno.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&TurnoId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarTurnosExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarTurnosExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTurnoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Turno")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFTurnoNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFTurnoNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Turno")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFTurnoNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTurnoHoraInicio.IsEmpty() AND &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Hora Inicio")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = &TFTurnoHoraInicio.ToFormattedString()
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Text = &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.ToFormattedString()
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTurnoHoraFin.IsEmpty() AND &TFTurnoHoraFin_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Hora Fin")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = &TFTurnoHoraFin.ToFormattedString()
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Text = &TFTurnoHoraFin_To.ToFormattedString()
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarTurnosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarTurnosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Turno
		order TurnoId  when &OrderedBy = 1
		order TurnoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TurnoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TurnoHoraInicio  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TurnoHoraInicio)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TurnoHoraFin  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TurnoHoraFin)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarTurnosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTurnoNombre, &TFTurnoNombre_Sel, &TFTurnoHoraInicio, &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To, &TFTurnoHoraFin
					, &TFTurnoHoraFin_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TurnoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(TurnoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TurnoHoraInicio'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = TurnoHoraInicio.ToFormattedString()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TurnoHoraFin'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = TurnoHoraFin.ToFormattedString()
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TurnoNombre", '', !'Turno', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TurnoHoraInicio", '', !'Hora Inicio', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TurnoHoraFin", '', !'Hora Fin', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarTurnosColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNONOMBRE"
				&TFTurnoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFTurnoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNOHORAINICIO"
				&TFTurnoHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNOHORAFIN"
				&TFTurnoHoraFin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTurnoHoraFin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(out:&Filename, out:&ErrorMessage);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarTurnosExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarturnos_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Turno List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFTurnoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFTurnoNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFTurnoNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFTurnoNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTurnoHoraInicio.IsEmpty() AND &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFTurnoHoraInicio
		&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Hora Inicio", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFTurnoHoraInicio_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTurnoHoraFin.IsEmpty() AND &TFTurnoHoraFin_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFTurnoHoraFin
		&TFTurnoHoraFin_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Hora Fin", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFTurnoHoraFin_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Turno
		order TurnoId  when &OrderedBy = 1
		order TurnoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TurnoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TurnoHoraInicio  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TurnoHoraInicio)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TurnoHoraFin  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TurnoHoraFin)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarTurnosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTurnoNombre, &TFTurnoNombre_Sel, &TFTurnoHoraInicio, &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To, &TFTurnoHoraFin
					, &TFTurnoHoraFin_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNONOMBRE"
				&TFTurnoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFTurnoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNOHORAINICIO"
				&TFTurnoHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNOHORAFIN"
				&TFTurnoHoraFin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTurnoHoraFin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarTurnosGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()

LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_TURNONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadTurnoNombreOptions'

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(WWPBaseObjects.LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarTurnosGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNONOMBRE"
				&TFTurnoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFTurnoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNOHORAINICIO"
				&TFTurnoHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTurnoHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTURNOHORAFIN"
				&TFTurnoHoraFin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTurnoHoraFin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadTurnoNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFTurnoNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFTurnoNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Turno
		Order TurnoNombre
		using listarTurnosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTurnoNombre, &TFTurnoNombre_Sel, &TFTurnoHoraInicio, &TFTurnoHoraInicio_To, &TFTurnoHoraFin
					, &TFTurnoHoraFin_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Turno
			Order TurnoNombre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not TurnoNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = TurnoNombre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
